We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to support ELC SOW 3, with a primary focus on business intelligence development, analytical asset creation, and data-driven insights. The role will contribute directly to the delivery of the first phase of the project and will be responsible for developing scalable, high-quality analytical solutions. The ideal candidate is highly experienced with Power BI and Looker, has strong Python and SQL skills, and brings strong analytical thinking with exposure to machine learning.
